# Introduction & Pipeline Overview

This document provides a modular, self-contained, and reproducible **Proteomics Analysis Pipeline** designed to ingest raw peptide/protein quantification data (e.g., Spectronaut, directLFQ, MaxQuant), perform rigorous univariate and multivariate QC (Inter-Sample Correlation), apply robust feature filtering and normalization, and fit linear models using **limma** and **DEqMS** (accounting for technical replicates and peptide count-based variance shrinkage).

### Key Workflow Steps:
1. **Pipeline Configuration**: Centralized parameter block to point to any new dataset.
2. **Metadata & Matrix Ingestion**: Automated column cleaning and sample alignment.
3. **Quality Control & Diagnostics**:
   - Sample-level protein identification depth.
   - Protein-level missingness distributions.
   - Multivariate QC via **Inter-Sample Correlation (IAC)** to assess sample connectivity and flag outliers ($Z < -3$ MAD).
4. **Feature Cleaning & Preprocessing**:
   - Contaminant detection and removal.
   - Group-wise completeness filtering ($\ge 70\%$ presence).
5. **Normalization & Missing Value Imputation**:
   - $Log_2$ transformation and sample-wise median centering.
   - Sample-minimum imputation for limit-of-detection values.
6. **Exploratory Data Analysis**:
   - Principal Component Analysis (PCA) with scree metrics.
7. **Peptide / Precursor Count Integration**:
   - Quantified precursor extraction for DEqMS variance weighting.
8. **Differential Expression Modeling (limma + DEqMS)**:
   - Consensus technical replicate correlation (`duplicateCorrelation`).
   - Flexible contrast testing.
   - Empirical Bayes shrinkage weighted by peptide counts (`spectraCounteBayes`).
9. **Visualizations & Export**:
   - Publication-ready Volcano plots.
   - Multi-tab Excel workbook export with summary metrics and hit tables.

---

# 1. Pipeline Configuration & Setup

Modify the paths and parameters in this block to run this pipeline on any new dataset.

```{r}
#| label: setup-and-config

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(limma)
  library(DEqMS)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(purrr)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Directory Path Resolution
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
proj_root    <- if (dir.exists("data")) "." else if (dir.exists("../data")) ".." else "."
path_data    <- file.path(proj_root, "data")
path_results <- file.path(proj_root, "results")
path_figs    <- file.path(proj_root, "figures")

dir.create(path_results, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(path_figs, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Input File Paths (Update these for a new dataset)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata CSV file
FILE_METADATA <- file.path(path_data, "Proteomics_metadata.csv")

# Protein intensity matrix (TSV or CSV: proteins in rows, samples in columns)
FILE_INTENSITY <- file.path(
  path_data, 
  "directlfq_on_cont_data", 
  "20261008_095241_20260618-1447_Report.tsv.protein_intensities.tsv"
)
# Fallback search if path changes
if (!file.exists(FILE_INTENSITY)) {
  cand <- list.files(file.path(path_data, "directlfq_on_cont_data"), pattern = "protein_intensities\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(cand) > 0) FILE_INTENSITY <- cand[1]
}

# Spectronaut peptide / precursor count file (for DEqMS variance modeling)
FILE_PEPTIDES <- file.path(path_data, "20260926_221340_20260618-1447_Report_peptide_numbers.tsv")
if (!file.exists(FILE_PEPTIDES)) {
  FILE_PEPTIDES <- file.path(path_data, "20260812_050914_20260618-1447_Report_pept_numbers.tsv")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Analysis Parameters & Filters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PARAM_SUBSET_SEX          <- "Female"   # Set to "Female", "Male", or NULL to include all
PARAM_MIN_COMPLETENESS    <- 0.70       # Require protein present in >= 70% in at least 1 group
PARAM_FILTER_CONTAMINANTS <- TRUE       # Remove contaminants matching regex
PARAM_CONTAMINANT_REGEX   <- "^Cont|^CON__"
PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF      <- 3.0        # Multivariate QC cutoff (-3 MAD below cohort median IAC)
PARAM_NORM_METHOD         <- "medianCentering" # "medianCentering" or "none"
PARAM_IMPUTE_METHOD       <- "sample_minimum"  # "sample_minimum" or "none"

# Output Excel Workbook
FILE_OUTPUT_XLSX <- file.path(path_results, "Proteomics_DEqMS_Analysis_Results.xlsx")

cat("Configuration successfully initialized.\n")
cat(sprintf("Intensity Matrix: %s\n", basename(FILE_INTENSITY)))
cat(sprintf("Metadata File:    %s\n", basename(FILE_METADATA)))
cat(sprintf("Peptide File:     %s\n", basename(FILE_PEPTIDES)))
```

# 2. Metadata Ingestion & Cohort Subsetting

```{r}
#| label: ingest-metadata

meta_raw <- read.table(FILE_METADATA, sep = ",", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Clean sample names and ensure replicate identifiers
meta_clean <- meta_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Mutation  = factor(Mutation, levels = c("WT", "AD")),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("CTRL", "UFP", "AN", "UFP_AN")),
    Sex       = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Sample_Clean = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", Sample_Name)
  )

# If technical duplicates (_01, _02) are not yet expanded, ensure 2 entries per biological sample
if (!any(grepl("_[0-9]+$", meta_clean$Sample_Name))) {
  rep1 <- meta_clean %>% mutate(Sample_Name = paste0(Sample_Clean, "_01"), Replicate = "01")
  rep2 <- meta_clean %>% mutate(Sample_Name = paste0(Sample_Clean, "_02"), Replicate = "02")
  meta_clean <- bind_rows(rep1, rep2) %>% arrange(Sample_Name)
} else {
  meta_clean <- meta_clean %>%
    mutate(Replicate = sub(".*_([0-9]+)$", "\\1", Sample_Name))
}

# Construct Combined Group Factor
meta_clean <- meta_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Combined_treatment = factor(
      paste(Sex, Mutation, Treatment, sep = "_")
    )
  )

# Apply optional cohort filter (e.g. Female only)
if (!is.null(PARAM_SUBSET_SEX)) {
  meta_active <- meta_clean %>%
    filter(Sex == PARAM_SUBSET_SEX) %>%
    droplevels()
} else {
  meta_active <- meta_clean
}

cat(sprintf("Loaded metadata for %d active samples across %d experimental groups:\n", 
            nrow(meta_active), nlevels(meta_active$Combined_treatment)))

table_summary <- meta_active %>%
  dplyr::count(Mutation, Treatment, Replicate) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
print(table_summary)
```

---

# 3. Protein Quantification Matrix Ingestion

```{r}
#| label: ingest-intensity-matrix

# Load intensity matrix
df_intensities <- read.delim(FILE_INTENSITY, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Extract protein IDs from first column
prot_id_col <- colnames(df_intensities)[1]
protein_identifiers <- df_intensities[[prot_id_col]]
mat_raw <- as.matrix(df_intensities[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(mat_raw) <- protein_identifiers

# Clean Spectronaut / directLFQ column headers to match Sample_Name (e.g., F001_01)
colnames(mat_raw) <- colnames(mat_raw) |>
  sub(pattern = ".*ASK_", replacement = "") |>
  sub(pattern = "\\.raw.*", replacement = "") |>
  sub(pattern = "^\\[[0-9]+\\]\\s*", replacement = "")

# Convert zeros to NAs (unquantified)
mat_raw[mat_raw == 0] <- NA

# Align samples between matrix and metadata
matched_samples <- intersect(meta_active$Sample_Name, colnames(mat_raw))
cat(sprintf("Aligned %d samples between metadata and intensity matrix (out of %d metadata samples).\n",
            length(matched_samples), nrow(meta_active)))

if (length(matched_samples) == 0) {
  stop("Zero sample IDs matched between metadata and quantification matrix. Please verify column naming.")
}

# Filter to matched samples
meta_active <- meta_active %>% filter(Sample_Name %in% matched_samples) %>% arrange(Sample_Name)
mat_active  <- mat_raw[, meta_active$Sample_Name, drop = FALSE]

cat(sprintf("Input matrix dimensions: %d proteins x %d samples.\n", nrow(mat_active), ncol(mat_active)))
```

## Multivariate QC: Inter-Sample Correlation (IAC)

Following the multivariate QC framework from `analysis.qmd` (Step 2 of sample filtering):
- Features with $\ge 70\%$ presence are used to calculate the pairwise Pearson correlation matrix ($r_{ij}$).
- Each sample's mean connectivity $\bar{r}_i$ to the cohort is evaluated:
  $$\bar{r}_i = \frac{1}{N - 1} \sum_{j \neq i} r_{ij}$$
- Robust Z-scores are computed using median and MAD:
  $$Z_i = \frac{\bar{r}_i - \text{median}(\bar{r})}{\text{MAD}(\bar{r})}$$
- Samples falling below $Z < -3$ MADs are flagged as correlation outliers.

```{r}
#| label: fig-multivariate-iac-qc
#| fig-cap: "Sample connectivity (Inter-Sample Correlation) and outlier detection"
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7

# Ensure log2 scale for correlation calculation
mat_iac_log <- if (max(mat_active, na.rm = TRUE) > 100) log2(mat_active + 1) else mat_active

# Filter for proteins present across sufficient samples
feature_present <- rowMeans(!is.na(mat_iac_log)) >= PARAM_MIN_COMPLETENESS
if (sum(feature_present) < 50) feature_present <- rowMeans(!is.na(mat_iac_log)) >= 0.50
mat_iac_probe <- mat_iac_log[feature_present, , drop = FALSE]

# Pairwise Pearson correlation matrix
cor_mat <- cor(mat_iac_probe, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
diag(cor_mat) <- NA
mean_iac <- colMeans(cor_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

# Robust Z-score
med_iac       <- median(mean_iac, na.rm = TRUE)
mad_iac       <- mad(mean_iac, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)
threshold_iac <- med_iac - (PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF * mad_iac)
iac_z         <- (mean_iac - med_iac) / mad_iac

df_iac <- tibble(
  Sample_Name   = names(mean_iac),
  Mean_IAC      = mean_iac,
  IAC_Zscore    = iac_z,
  Fail_IAC      = iac_z < -PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF,
  Decision      = if_else(iac_z < -PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF, "Discard (Correlation Outlier)", "Keep for Imputation")
) %>%
  left_join(meta_active, by = "Sample_Name")

cat(sprintf("Multivariate IAC Summary: %d probe features used | Median IAC = %.4f | Outliers (< -%.1f MAD): %d\n",
            nrow(mat_iac_probe), med_iac, PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF, sum(df_iac$Fail_IAC)))

# Connectivity Dot Plot
p_iac <- ggplot(df_iac, aes(x = reorder(Sample_Name, Mean_IAC), y = Mean_IAC, color = Decision)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = med_iac, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = threshold_iac, linetype = "dotted", color = "#D62728", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Keep for Imputation" = "#2CA02C", "Discard (Correlation Outlier)" = "#D62728")) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5), legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Sample Connectivity (Mean Inter-Sample Correlation)",
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed = Median (%.3f) | Dotted = -%.1f MAD Threshold (%.3f)", med_iac, PARAM_IAC_MAD_CUTOFF, threshold_iac),
    x = "Sample ID",
    y = "Mean Pairwise Pearson r",
    color = "QC Decision"
  )

print(p_iac)
```

# 5. Feature Filtering & Contaminant Removal

```{r}
#| label: filter-proteins

# 1. Group-wise Completeness Filtering
# Keep proteins detected in >= 70% of samples in at least one biological group
filter_proteins_by_group <- function(mat, metadata, group_col = "Combined_treatment", min_completeness = 0.70) {
  groups <- unique(metadata[[group_col]])
  keep_proteins <- logical(nrow(mat))
  
  for (g in groups) {
    samples_in_g <- metadata %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] == g) %>% pull(Sample_Name)
    samples_in_g <- intersect(samples_in_g, colnames(mat))
    
    if (length(samples_in_g) > 0) {
      sub_mat <- mat[, samples_in_g, drop = FALSE]
      group_completeness <- rowMeans(!is.na(sub_mat))
      keep_proteins <- keep_proteins | (group_completeness >= min_completeness)
    }
  }
  return(mat[keep_proteins, , drop = FALSE])
}

mat_filtered <- filter_proteins_by_group(
  mat = mat_active,
  metadata = meta_active,
  group_col = "Combined_treatment",
  min_completeness = PARAM_MIN_COMPLETENESS
)

# 2. Contaminant Removal
if (PARAM_FILTER_CONTAMINANTS) {
  is_cont <- grepl(rownames(mat_filtered), pattern = PARAM_CONTAMINANT_REGEX)
  mat_filtered <- mat_filtered[!is_cont, , drop = FALSE]
  cat(sprintf("Removed %d contaminant proteins matching '%s'.\n", sum(is_cont), PARAM_CONTAMINANT_REGEX))
}

cat(sprintf("Retained %d high-confidence endogenous proteins after completeness filtering.\n", nrow(mat_filtered)))
```

# 6. Normalization (Median Centering)

```{r}
#| label: normalize-intensities

normalize_matrix <- function(mat, method = c("medianCentering", "none"), log_base = 2) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  
  # Ensure Log2 transformation
  if (max(mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 100) {
    mat <- log((mat + 1), base = log_base)
  }
  
  if (method == "medianCentering") {
    sample_medians <- apply(mat, 2, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE)
    global_median  <- stats::median(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    mat <- base::sweep(mat, 2, sample_medians, FUN = "-") + global_median
  }
  
  return(mat)
}

mat_norm <- normalize_matrix(mat_filtered, method = PARAM_NORM_METHOD)
```

# 7. Missing Value Imputation

```{r}
#| label: impute-missing-values

if (PARAM_IMPUTE_METHOD == "sample_minimum") {
  # Sample-minimum imputation (impute per sample using its observed minimum)
  mat_imputed <- as.data.frame(mat_norm) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
    as.matrix()
} else {
  mat_imputed <- mat_norm
}

cat(sprintf("Imputation complete (%s). Total NA values remaining: %d\n", 
            PARAM_IMPUTE_METHOD, sum(is.na(mat_imputed))))
```

```{r}
print(p_pca)
```

# 9. Extract Peptide / Precursor Counts for DEqMS

`DEqMS` utilizes quantified peptide/precursor ion counts to shrink protein variance according to quantification confidence.

```{r}
#| label: extract-peptide-counts

final_proteins <- rownames(mat_imputed)

if (file.exists(FILE_PEPTIDES)) {
  pep_raw <- read.delim(FILE_PEPTIDES, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  id_col_pep <- colnames(pep_raw)[1]
  rownames(pep_raw) <- pep_raw[[id_col_pep]]
  
  colnames(pep_raw) <- colnames(pep_raw) |>
    sub(pattern = ".*ASK_", replacement = "") |>
    sub(pattern = "\\.raw.*", replacement = "_peptides")
  
  target_pep_cols  <- paste(meta_active$Sample_Name, "peptides", sep = "_")
  matched_pep_cols <- intersect(target_pep_cols, colnames(pep_raw))
  
  if (length(matched_pep_cols) > 0) {
    sub_pep <- pep_raw[final_proteins, matched_pep_cols, drop = FALSE]
    pep_counts <- apply(sub_pep, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
    pep_counts[is.na(pep_counts) | pep_counts < 1] <- 1
  } else {
    pep_counts <- setNames(rep(1, length(final_proteins)), final_proteins)
  }
} else {
  warning("Peptide count file not found. Defaulting to equal weighting (count = 1).")
  pep_counts <- setNames(rep(1, length(final_proteins)), final_proteins)
}

pep_counts <- pep_counts[final_proteins]
cat(sprintf("Peptide counts mapped for %d proteins (Median = %.0f precursors per protein).\n",
            length(pep_counts), median(pep_counts)))
```

---

# 10. Linear Modeling (limma) & DEqMS Variance Modeling

We construct the design matrix for all experimental conditions, account for technical duplicate runs using `duplicateCorrelation`, fit linear models, and perform DEqMS variance shrinkage.

```{r}
#| label: deqms-modeling

# 1. Design Matrix
design_mat <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Combined_treatment, data = meta_active)
colnames(design_mat) <- levels(meta_active$Combined_treatment)

# 2. Estimate Technical Replicate Correlation (Paired Runs)
dup_corr <- duplicateCorrelation(
  mat_imputed, 
  design = design_mat, 
  block = meta_active$Replicate
)

cat(sprintf("Consensus technical replicate correlation: %.3f\n", dup_corr$consensus.correlation))

# 3. Fit Linear Model with Block Correlation
fit_lm <- lmFit(
  mat_imputed, 
  design = design_mat, 
  block = meta_active$Replicate, 
  correlation = dup_corr$consensus.correlation
)

# 4. Construct Experimental Contrasts
# Note: Adjust contrast formulas if grouping factor names differ
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  # WT Treatment Effects
  WT_Effect_UFP    = Female_WT_UFP - Female_WT_CTRL,
  WT_Effect_AN     = Female_WT_AN - Female_WT_CTRL,
  WT_Effect_UFP_AN = Female_WT_UFP_AN - Female_WT_CTRL,

  # AD Treatment Effects
  AD_Effect_UFP    = Female_AD_UFP - Female_AD_CTRL,
  AD_Effect_AN     = Female_AD_AN - Female_AD_CTRL,
  AD_Effect_UFP_AN = Female_AD_UFP_AN - Female_AD_CTRL,

  # Genotype Effects
  AD_vs_WT_CTRL    = Female_AD_CTRL - Female_WT_CTRL,
  AD_vs_WT_UFP     = Female_AD_UFP - Female_WT_UFP,
  AD_vs_WT_AN      = Female_AD_AN - Female_WT_AN,
  AD_vs_WT_UFP_AN  = Female_AD_UFP_AN - Female_WT_UFP_AN,

  levels = design_mat
)

fit_contrasts <- contrasts.fit(fit_lm, contrast_matrix)

# 5. DEqMS Variance Shrinkage
fit_contrasts$count <- as.numeric(pep_counts)
fit_contrasts <- eBayes(fit_contrasts)
fit_deqms <- spectraCounteBayes(fit_contrasts)
```

## DEqMS Diagnostic Variance Boxplot

```{r}
#| label: fig-deqms-variance-curve
#| fig-cap: "DEqMS variance shrinkage curve against precursor counts"
VarianceBoxplot(fit_deqms, n = 20, xlab = "Peptide / Precursor Count")
```

---

# 11. Extract Differential Abundance Results

```{r}
#| label: extract-contrast-results

contrast_cols <- colnames(contrast_matrix)
results_list  <- list()

for (cn in contrast_cols) {
  res_df <- outputResult(fit_deqms, coef_col = cn) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Protein_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      Contrast = cn,
      Significant_FDR05 = !is.na(sca.adj.pval) & sca.adj.pval < 0.05,
      Significant_P05   = !is.na(sca.P.Value) & sca.P.Value < 0.05
    ) %>%
    arrange(sca.adj.pval)
  
  results_list[[cn]] <- res_df
}

# Summary table of significant hits
df_summary_hits <- tibble(
  Contrast = contrast_cols,
  Total_Tested = map_int(results_list, nrow),
  Hits_FDR05   = map_int(results_list, ~ sum(.x$Significant_FDR05)),
  Hits_Nominal = map_int(results_list, ~ sum(.x$Significant_P05))
)

print(df_summary_hits)
```

## Volcano Plots for Primary Exposure Contrasts

```{r}
#| label: fig-volcano-plots
#| fig-cap: "Volcano plots across experimental contrasts"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

plots_volcano <- list()

for (cn in contrast_cols[1:min(6, length(contrast_cols))]) {
  df_v <- results_list[[cn]] %>%
    mutate(
      Status = case_when(
        Significant_FDR05 & logFC > 0 ~ "Up (FDR < 0.05)",
        Significant_FDR05 & logFC < 0 ~ "Down (FDR < 0.05)",
        Significant_P05               ~ "Nominal p < 0.05",
        TRUE                          ~ "Not Sig"
      )
    )
  
  p_volc <- ggplot(df_v, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(sca.P.Value), color = Status)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Up (FDR < 0.05)"   = "#d73027",
      "Down (FDR < 0.05)" = "#4575b4",
      "Nominal p < 0.05"  = "#fdae61",
      "Not Sig"           = "grey80"
    )) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = cn,
      subtitle = sprintf("Hits FDR < 0.05: %d", sum(df_v$Significant_FDR05)),
      x = expression(Log[2]~Fold~Change),
      y = expression(-Log[10]~Nominal~p)
    )
  
  plots_volcano[[cn]] <- p_volc
}

wrap_plots(plots_volcano, ncol = 3)
```

# 12. Export Multi-Sheet Excel Workbook

```{r}
#| label: export-results-workbook

wb <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet 1: Summary of Hits
addWorksheet(wb, "Summary_Hits")
writeData(wb, "Summary_Hits", df_summary_hits)
freezePane(wb, "Summary_Hits", firstRow = TRUE)

# Sheet 2: Multivariate IAC Metrics
addWorksheet(wb, "QC_Sample_Connectivity_IAC")
writeData(wb, "QC_Sample_Connectivity_IAC", df_iac)
freezePane(wb, "QC_Sample_Connectivity_IAC", firstRow = TRUE)

# Sheets for Each Contrast
for (cn in names(results_list)) {
  sheet_name <- substr(gsub("[: ]+", "_", cn), 1, 31)
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, results_list[[cn]])
  freezePane(wb, sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, FILE_OUTPUT_XLSX, overwrite = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Full results workbook successfully saved to:\n  %s\n", FILE_OUTPUT_XLSX))
```
